bio: From the black and white floor tiles and bistro chairs to the enamel signs that adorn the walls and the ever-present buzzy vibe, this neighbourhood bistro oozes character. What’s more, the slate menu will set your tastebuds drooling: melt-in-the-mouth country pâté with a dash of cognac, pork cheeks simmered lovingly in beer or chicory gratin crafted with old-school textbook precision. The predominantly Gallic score is rolled out playfully, as are the vegetarian dishes, and every bite is followed by a wallop of gusto. Ideal for a hearty satisfying meal without breaking the bank....
